title: describe_layer inputSchema
description: Argument shape for describing a single published layer's field schema, row count, geometry type, spatial reference, and extent. The bare standard taxonomy models layer schema as a CapabilityCatalog read; the reference implementation exposes it as a discrete tool (advertised name honua_describe_layer). x-honua-extension: this is a documented Honua extension over the bare taxonomy, pending formalization in the geospatial-mcp standard. x-honua-reference-shape: this shape tracks the reference implementation.

serviceId.description: Published service identifier or name (from honua_list_layers.serviceId).

includeRowCount.description: When false, skip the row-count probe and omit rowCount.
